description: Publishes or updates the domain's DMARC record: the policy, the address DMARC reports are sent to, and the other DMARC tags DNS Toolbox recommends after scanning the domain.
variableDescription: dmarc: the DMARC tags after the version, e.g. 'p=quarantine; rua=mailto:r-a1b2c3@dmarc.dnstoolbox.app'.
